log.content: Pipe smoke and cheap wine in a Salt Road tavern booth. Vessa sits across the sticky wood and wants a cutter. She keeps a silver pouch under her hand and waits to hear what you call yourself.

Who you are: a cutter on the Salt Road crew, starting at a Salt Road tavern hire
How you got here: Vessa wants a cutter and a name she can use.
Location: a Salt Road tavern hire
Who is here / who summoned: Vessa
What's pressing: Vessa wants a cutter and a name she can use. Vessa is waiting on your move.
If you refuse: The watch is already in the door. She can leave you to them.
openingEstablishment.pickedHookFallback: Pipe smoke and cheap wine in a Salt Road tavern booth. Vessa sits across the sticky wood and wants a cutter. The score is local politics wearing a padlock; rivals are buying names before you have one. The door opens on two watchmen scanning the room. She keeps a silver pouch under her hand and waits to hear what you call yourself.
